company.name: Aqua Ventures
company.description: Aqua Ventures is an innovative 10-acre integrated aqua-farm and estate agro-ecology sanctuary located along a clean Cauvery tributary in Siddapur, Coorg. We pioneer clean recirculating aquaculture (Tilapia), high-tech soilless hydroponics, scientific apiculture (bee-keeping), and artisan Kodava culinary preserves under the brands Just Meen, Just Homemade, Just Fresh, and Vinessence.

delivery.policy: We operate a certified sub-zero cold-chain delivery network to guarantee zero spoilage from farm to doorstep.

zones.Bangalore: Next-day cold-chain dispatch (Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays) via thermal insulated containers packed with dry ice gel packs. Free delivery on orders over ₹1,500.
zones.Mysore: Next-day direct refrigerated delivery. Free delivery on orders over ₹1,200.
zones.Mangalore: Next-day express cold-chain coastal run. Free delivery on orders over ₹1,500.
zones.Coorg: Same-day or next-day direct farm dispatch across Madikeri, Virajpet, Siddapur, Gonikoppal, and Kushalnagar. Farm gate pickup also available.
zones.RestOfIndia: Ambient shelf-stable products (Kachampuli, Kaipuli Marmalade, Pickles, Vinessence Millet mixes, and Honey) ship pan-India via express air courier in 2-4 business days.

delivery.packaging: Frozen fish and prawns are packed in food-grade vacuum pouches, nestled in insulated thermocol coolers with sub-zero gel packs maintaining below -15°C for 36 hours.

faqs.question: Is your Tilapia muddy or smelly like pond fish?
faqs.answer: Absolutely not! Muddy taste in fish comes from geosmin produced by algae in stagnant pond mud. At Aqua Ventures, our Tilapia are raised in high-flow, oxygenated mountain spring water in clean concrete raceways with zero bottom silt. The result is pure, clean, sweet white meat with zero muddy odor.

faqs.question: How should I thaw and cook the Tilapia Fillets?
faqs.answer: Thaw the vacuum-sealed pack in cold water for 15-20 minutes, or in your refrigerator overnight. Do not microwave thaw. The fillets are boneless and delicate; pan-sear in butter with garlic and lemon for 3-4 minutes per side, or gently poach in a spicy Coorg curry.

faqs.question: What is Kachampuli and how do I use it?
faqs.answer: Kachampuli is the holy grail of Coorg cuisine! It is a pure, woodfire-reduced extract of wild Garcinia gummi-gutta fruit. It has a glossy ink-black color and an intensely fruity, complex tartness. Unlike vinegar or tamarind, you only need 3 to 5 drops at the very end of cooking pork, fish, or chicken curry to balance richness and tenderize the meat.

faqs.question: What happens on the Farm Tour?
faqs.answer: Our 3.5-hour Integrated Farm Tour costs ₹1,500 per adult (₹800 for kids). You get a guided tour of the aquaculture raceways with hands-on fish feeding, an inspection of our climate-controlled hydroponics greenhouse, an apiary walk tasting raw honeycomb, and a lavish farm-to-table lunch featuring our fresh fish and estate-grown specialties by the Cauvery riverbank.

faqs.question: Do you sell live fish fingerlings for commercial ponds?
faqs.answer: Yes! We supply commercial fingerlings of Catla (₹2.20), Rohu (₹2.20), Grass Carp (₹2.20), and Murrel (₹10.00) with full aquaculture advisory. For commercial enquiries over 1,000 fingerlings, our founder Shyam Aiyappa personally coordinates logistics and water quality guidance.

faqs.question: What payment modes are supported?
faqs.answer: We support all major payment modes via Razorpay (UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking) as well as direct WhatsApp payment links.
